title: Validate Skill output against its declared schema
goal: Ensure executeVerified rejects executor output that violates the installed Skill manifest output schema, independently of the executor-provided verifier.
context: SkillRuntime validates inputJSON against inputSchema but currently trusts executor.verify as the only output gate. A custom executor whose verifier returns true can expose JSON that violates outputSchema.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken policy, Agent scope, cancellation, executor registration, or fail-closed behavior.
Do not change public APIs, UI, provider routing, or unrelated runtime modules.
Do not claim tests or CI passed without actual evidence.
acceptance_criteria: executeVerified validates executor output against manifest.outputSchema before returning it.
Output violating the schema fails with a typed verification error even if executor.verify returns true.
Valid output that passes both schema validation and executor verification remains supported.
The focused Skill executor tests and full Swift package tests pass, and CI gates pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if output validation breaks valid executor contracts; retain fail-closed behavior and adjust only the validator boundary and focused regression test.
